title: New York State / US federal threshold pack (with EFSA dose reference and the Maine milk line)

legend.legal_status: in_force | future (adopted, compliance or application date ahead) | guidance (official non-binding value, benchmark or recommendation) | orientation (classification or literature criterion, not a norm) | superseded | requirement (procedure, no number) | proposed (proposed by the issuing body, not adopted)
legend.verified: verified = confirmed against the issuing body's own document; verified-secondary = confirmed through an authoritative secondary source, primary text not opened [provisional]; corrected = the v0.1 line was wrong or incomplete and is restated here; not-verified = not confirmed, kept and flagged, never silently removed

rows.applicability: community and non-transient non-community systems; private well — reference by analogy
rows.determination_rule: running annual average (RAA) at the sampling point
rows.source_doc: PFAS NPDWR (final 10 Apr 2024); proposed rule 'Extending the Compliance Deadline for the PFOA and PFOS MCLs', Federal Register 20 May 2026
rows.v01_line: Drinking water, US EPA: PFOA and PFOS, MCL 4.0 ng/L each; mandatory compliance from 2029
rows.note: MCL value unchanged. Compliance date in the 2024 rule: 26 Apr 2029. EPA proposed (18 May 2026) a federal exemption letting eligible systems comply by 26 Apr 2031 — proposed, not final at the check date. Before compliance, comparisons are screening only (status max yellow).

rows.analyte: PFHxS; PFNA; HFPO-DA (each); Hazard Index mixture
rows.applicability: as NYUS-03
rows.determination_rule: RAA
rows.source_doc: PFAS NPDWR 2024; EPA proposal of 18 May 2026 to rescind these determinations and MCLs
rows.note: Added because PFNA and PFHxS are half of the EFSA sum. Proposed for rescission — use as orientation only until EPA decides.

rows.applicability: public water systems; private well — reference by analogy
rows.determination_rule: single sample below MCL suffices; a result above the MCL needs a confirmation sample (40 CFR 141.23)
rows.v01_line: Well nitrate: EPA MCL 10 mg/L as nitrogen
rows.note: Set to avoid methemoglobinemia in infants (EPA memo 30 Nov 2020). Nitrite MCL 1 mg/L as N; total nitrate+nitrite 10 mg/L as N.

rows.applicability: biosolids sources (water resource recovery facilities) supplying permitted 361-2/361-3 facilities
rows.determination_rule: ≤20: no action; >20 and <50: additional sampling, DEC may restrict if not reduced below 20 (single reported result triggers the tier)
rows.source_doc: Program Policy DMM-7 'Biosolids Recycling in New York State – Interim Strategy for the Control of PFAS Compounds'
rows.v01_line: Biosolids, NYS DEC DMM-7 interim strategy: PFOS attention level 20 ppb in biosolids
rows.note: The tier applies to PFOS OR PFOA, not PFOS alone; 'attention level' is not DEC's term. DEC requires quarterly sampling of recycled biosolids sources under DMM-7. Interim DEC program policy, applied through Part 361 permits.

rows.applicability: as NYUS-07
rows.determination_rule: ≥50: DEC takes action to prohibit recycling until the level is below 20
rows.source_doc: DMM-7
rows.v01_line: (implicit in the simulation, not in v0.1 pack)
rows.note: Interim DEC program policy, applied through Part 361 permits.

rows.applicability: permitted 361-3 facilities and approved out-of-state products
rows.determination_rule: initial sampling within 90 days of 10 Jun 2026, then annually at the frequency in the policy
rows.source_doc: Program Policy DMM-7A 'Interim Strategy to Address PFAS in Biosolids Products'
rows.v01_line: DMM-7A (2026-06-10) requires testing of biosolids products
rows.note: Covers biosolids PRODUCTS. Class B biosolids land-applied from a source fall under DMM-7 (quarterly source sampling), not DMM-7A.

rows.applicability: tolerable weekly intake (TWI) — health-based reference, used in both packs
rows.determination_rule: long-term average intake compared with the TWI; incomplete sums are lower bounds
rows.source_doc: EFSA CONTAM Panel (2020) Risk to human health related to the presence of perfluoroalkyl substances in food. EFSA Journal 18(9):6223, doi:10.2903/j.efsa.2020.6223
rows.v01_line: Consumer dose reference, EFSA: tolerable weekly intake 4.4 ng/kg body weight per week for the sum PFOS + PFOA + PFNA + PFHxS
rows.note: Critical effect: reduced vaccine response; the BMDL was identified for 1-year-old children — the sensitive-group scenario is mandatory (references/dose-scenarios.md).

rows.applicability: EPA 304(a) recommendation; binding values are the state's adopted standards; a farm stream is orientation only
rows.determination_rule: geometric mean over the state's averaging period
rows.source_doc: EPA 2012 Recreational Water Quality Criteria (EPA-820-F-12-058); EPA parameter factsheet E. coli (EPA 841F21007F, 2021)
rows.v01_line: EPA recreational criteria for E. coli (geometric mean 126 …)
rows.note: Alternative set: GM 100 / STV 320.

rows.applicability: as NYUS-11
rows.determination_rule: 90th percentile; not to be exceeded by more than 10 % of samples in the averaging period
rows.source_doc: EPA 2012 RWQC; EPA factsheet 2021
rows.note: The current EPA recommendation pairs GM 126 with STV 410, not with 235.

rows.analyte: E. coli — single-sample maximum (1986) / Beach Action Value (2012, optional)
rows.applicability: 1986 criteria SSM; in 2012 retained only as an optional beach-notification value
rows.determination_rule: single sample (beach notification use only)
rows.source_doc: EPA 1986 criteria; EPA 2012 RWQC (BAV); summarised in MDE factsheet Jan 2013
rows.source_org: US EPA (via Maryland Department of the Environment)
rows.note: Kept, marked superseded — not removed silently.

rows.v01_line: (task line) Maine action level for PFOS in milk 210 ng/L — if confirmed
rows.note: Confirmed. Maine also set 3.4 ng/g (µg/kg) PFOS in beef (2020), row NYUS-15.

rows.applicability: Maine; elsewhere by analogy

rows.applicability: NYS DEC rural background concentration — a background reference, not a limit
rows.determination_rule: comparison with background only

rows.v01_line: (simulation 1) 'DEC draft for agricultural soils, maximum PFOS 3.0 µg/kg, not adopted'
rows.note: The simulation's wording is NOT confirmed: 3.0 µg/kg is DEC's rural BACKGROUND value for PFOS, not a draft maximum. DEC soil guidance values (CP-51 draft) were not retrieved.

rows.v01_line: (simulation 2) 'upper part of the range typical for dairy farms' — unsourced
rows.note: Denominator: sources differ (blog: total farm acreage; NMSP 2024 talk: tillable hectare). Report both.

rows.applicability: US Grade A milk under the Pasteurized Milk Ordinance as adopted by the states
rows.determination_rule: NY: limit on prepasteurized producer milk (1 NYCRR §2.8); PMO enforcement rule (three of the last four samples) not re-read in this check
rows.note: Two independent sources agree (NY regulation text via Justia; AVMA on the PMO). Official NYCRR publisher not opened, so the mark stays secondary. AVMA supports lowering to 400,000 cells/mL; NCIMS has not adopted it.
rows.matrix: raw cow's milk (Grade A, individual producer)
rows.source_doc: 1 NYCRR §2.8 Quality standards — prepasteurized milk for Grade A use: somatic cells 'not to exceed 750,000 per ml. for prepasteurized milk from cows'; same value in the Grade 'A' Pasteurized Milk Ordinance (AVMA policy page)
rows.source_org: NYS Department of Agriculture and Markets (regulation text via Justia reproduction); FDA/NCIMS PMO (value via AVMA)

rows.applicability: FDA action level; legal action considered above it

rows.applicability: FDA action level; not binding on courts, industry or agency
